title: AVOTAN ® POUR-ON
html:
Description

AVONTAN POUR-ON is a ready to use pour-on for the effective control of roundworms and blue ticks in cattle.

title: EZYFLOW LIME SC
html:
Description

A highly concentrated fully water dispersible liquid fertilizer containing a high percentage of Calcium for use in plant development.

title: REFLEXX 120 EC
html:
Description

REFLEXX 120 EC is a selective post-emergent herbicide for the control of Nutsedge, Broadleaf and Grass weeds in groundnuts, Soyabeans and Sugar beans, as well as on Chickpeas and Lupin.

title: CISLIN PLUS SC
html:
Description

Cislin Plus SC is an effective control against crawling and flying insects

title: BARRIER TERMITICIDE EC
html:
Description

BARRIER TERMICIDE EC is an effective control for both subterranean and harvester termites

title: SHUMBA APHID KILL
html:
Description

Shumba Aphid Kill effectively controls aphids on vegetable plants.

title: NOBIVAC® RABIES
html:
Description

Nobivac® Rabies is used for the immunisation of dogs, cats, cattle, sheep, goats, and horses against rabies. It can be used for both prophylactic immunisation and post bit therapy.

title: ESTRUMATE™
html:
Description

Estrumate is used for estrus synchronisation and stud management.

Cattle

  • Estrus Synchronisation
  • Treatment of non-detected estrus associated with a functioning of persistent corpus luteum, chronic endometritis/pyometra and treatment of ovation luteal cysts
  • Induction of parturition
  • Termination of pregnancy

Horses

  • As an aid to stud management
  • Treatment of conditions associated with a functioning persistent corpus luteum

title: VIBRIN®
html:
Description

Vibrin® is for vaccination of healthy cows and heifers as an aid in preventing campylobacteriosis (vibriosis) caused by Campylobacter fetus.

title: ROTAVEC® CORONA
html:
Description

Rotavec® Corona is used for the active immunisation of pregnant cows and heifers to raise antibodies against E. coli adhesion E5 (K99) antigen, rotavirus, and coronavirus. These antibodies protect calves against these diseases. Whilst calves are fed colostrum from vaccinated cows during the first two to four weeks of life, these antibodies have been demonstrated to:

  • Reduce the severity of diarrhoea caused by E. coli F5 (K99)
  • Reduce the incidence of scours caused by rotavirus
  • Reduce the shedding of virus by calves infected with rotavirus or coronavirus

title: RB-51
html:
Description

RB-51 is for use in healthy female cattle as an aid in the prevention of infection and abortion caused by Brucella abortus, can be used in cattle more than 10months of age.

title: PRONDIVAX PULPY KIDNEY
html:
Description

Prondivax Pulpy Kidney is used for the active immunisation of sheep and goat against pulpy kidney.

title: PRONDISTAR
html:
Description

Pondistar is used for the immunisation of cattle, sheep and goats against anthrax, blackleg (black quarter) and botulism.

title: MULTIVAX-P
html:
Description

Multivax-P is for the active immunisation of sheep against pulpy kidney, malignant oedema, black quarter, tetanus and pasteurellosis.

title: LUMPYVAX
html:
Description

Lumpyvax is for the prophylactic immunisation of cattle against lumpy skin disease.

title: BOVI-MIN GEL
html:
Description

Bovi-Min Gel is used for optimum fertility, immunity, and growth in cattle.

title: PARVEXON PLUS
html:
Description

PARVEXON PLUS is a potent injection treatment for Theileriosis (East Coast Fever), particularly for advanced cases with pulmonary oedema. PARVEXON PLUS contains 150 mg/mℓ Parvaquone and 55mg/mℓ Frusemide. Parvaquone is theilericidal, acting on schizonts and piroplasm. Frusemide is a diuretic, which resolves pulmonary oedema.

title: PANACUR ® BS
html:
Description

Panacur ® BS is an anthelmintic for cattle, sheep, goats, horses, and ostriches. A roundworm remedy for cattle, horses, and ostriches. A roundworm, lungworm and milk tapeworm remedy for sheep and goats.

title: Pulse Wax Blocks
html:
Description

Pulse Wax Blocks are highly active anti-coagulant bait for the control of the Norway rat, roof rat, the house mouse and gerbil. For use in the home, on the farm and industrial premises

title: NILZAN BOLUS
html:
Description

Nilzan Bolus is a cost effective de-wormer for the treatment and control of the main gastrointestinal roundworms and liver fluke in cattle. It is also highly convenient for lactating dairy cows (zero milk withdrawal). It is safe for use in young, pregnant and lactating animals.

title: D.B.M CONCENTRATE FOR FLY CONTROL
html:
Description

DBM concentrate is the product of choice for fly control in all places where flies breed and infest. These areas include refuse dumps, manure pits, dairies, cowsheds, stables, pigsties, fowl runs and around abattoirs.

title: AFRI-BIOPIT
html:
Description

Afri-Biopit is a proprietary blend of microbes, surfactants and emulsifiers for the biological remediation and maintenance of pit-latrines.

title: SOLUTION R
html:
Description

An antiparasitic remedy for cattle, horses and sheep.

title: BIMECTIN INJECTION
html:
Description

For the control of worms and blue ticks in cattle and sheep, as well as worms and mange mites in pigs. Effective against all species of gastro-intestinal worms, including the 4th stage larvae, and blue ticks (R B decoloratus and R B microplus), including those resistant to topical acaricides. Bimectin is also effective against Thelazia eye worms, nasal worm in sheep, sarcoptic and psoriatic mange mites and sucking lice.

Bimectin prevents re-infection with worms for 14 to 21 days depending on species. As the larvae are killed, pasture re-infestation is controlled for 6 to 8 weeks. Blue ticks are controlled for a minimum of 3 weeks.

title: VIRAFORCE
html:
Description

Alcohol based hand sanitiser. An instant powerful hand sanitiser, effective against viruses, fungi and bacteria. Proven to kill 99.99% of pathogens. 70% alcohol. Non-staining. Safe and effective.

title: SHUMBA PLUS DUST
html:
Description

Shumba Plus Dust is a grain and cereal protect ant dust for use in protection of stored grain, dried beans and cereals against stored product insect pests. It is also effective in the control of house ants, cockroaches, bedbugs and fleas.

title: SHUMBA SUPERMAX EC50
html:
Description

Controls stored grain insect pests including weevils, lesser and larger grain borers, moths and dried bean beetles. Can also be used to control ants and cockroaches.

title: Fly Zone
html:
Description

An effective bag fly trap with bait.

title: Fly Buster Bait – Refill
html:
Description

Fly bait with strong odour that attracts flies. Does not contain toxins or poisons.

PACK SIZE
Refill bait for use with one Flybuster bucket

title: FLY BUSTER BUCKET AND BAIT
html:
Description

An effective bucket fly trap which traps and kills flies within at least 15 metres of areas to be protected. Contains no poisons or toxins.

title: Torch 200SL
html:
Description

Torch 200SL is a broad spectrum non selective post emergent herbicide with some systemic action for the control of broadleaf and grass weeds. For use on apples, citrus, coffee, cotton, maize, pears and vines, no-crop, and industrial areas. This herbicide is a water-soluble liquid with a wetting agent.

title: HALO 5CS
html:
Description

Halo 5CS is recommended for the control of agricultural and public health pests only. For use on crops of brassicas, cotton, maize, potato, soybean, tobacco, tomato

title: ECOTOPP
html:
Description

Ecotopp is an effective systemic Suckercide, that inhibits the growth of suckers in tobacco.

title: ECOTEREX 0.5GR
html:
Description

ECOTEREX 0.5GR is a granular stomach and contact insecticide for the control of fall army worm (Spodoptera frugiperda) and maize stalk borer (Busseola fusca) for use in maize and traditional grains. Ecoterex 0.5GR provides one treatment for two pests.

title: ECOTEREX 30EC
html:
Description

Ecoterex 30EC is a liquid EC stomach and contact insecticide for the control of maize stalk borer (Busseola fusca) and fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) in maize, sorghum, wheat, barley, and rice.

title: DECATOPP
html:
Description

Decatopp is an emulsifiable concentrate and a plant growth regulator. Decatopp is a combination-type tobacco sucker control agent for the control of sucker growth and development on flue cured Virginia and air-cured barley tobacco.

title: QUATERGENT
html:
Description

Quatergent is a combined liquid detergent and disinfectant. For use in food processing establishments, hatcheries, hotels and butcheries. Contains quaternary ammonium compounds. Quatergent is non-tainting, non-staining, non-corrosive and odorless.

title: PYNOL
html:
Description

Pynol Disinfectant is a high quality disinfectant for the medical profession, personal hygiene and general use. For use in medical facilities, mortuaries, households and general hygiene.

Benefits:

  • Harmless in septic tanks (if used as directed)
  • Non poisonous
  • Non irritant
  • Non staining
  • Refreshing, deodorant , pine – scented

title: MICROL
html:
Description

Microl is a powerful general-purpose disinfectant with a characteristic smell. It is dirty-whitish in colour and turns into a dirty milky emulsion when diluted with water. It is used for general disinfections in communal toilets, sheds, cattle trucks, abattoirs, pig sties, fowl runs, stables, factories and general disinfection of refuse bin areas. Microl is also used in foot and vehicle wheel baths in bio-security areas.

title: KEROL
html:
Description

Kerol Disinfectant is the ultimate solution in ensuring that your farm equipment and tools are kept clean & free from bacteria. Can also be used in animal sickrooms.

title: CONCENTRATED TOILET CLEANER
html:
Description

A clear, honey coloured pine scented liquid used as a toilet cleaner.

title: BIODAN
html:
Description

Biodan is an iodine based sterilizer and detergent for use in dairies and food premises.

title: BACTERGENT
html:
Description

DESCRIPTION

Bactergent is a stable, fine, free-flowing whitish powder. It is a powerful combined detergent and bactericide for washing and sterilizing equipment, utensils and all working surfaces in food premises as well as dairies. Effective for use in food premises, abattoirs, dairies, butcheries, mortuaries etc.

title: RESKOL
html:
Description

Reskol is a residual organophosphate base insecticide for public health and industrial use, and is particularly effective on all crawling insects, mosquitoes and mosquito larvae.

title: PULSE PELLETS
html:
Description

Pulse Pellets are highly active anti-coagulant bait for the control of the Norway rat, roof rat, the house mouse and gerbil. For use in the home, on the farm and industrial premises

title: PULSE LIQUID BAIT
html:
Description

Pulse Liquid Bait is a highly active anti-coagulant bait for the control of the Norway rat, roof rat, house mouse and gerbil. For household, hospitality and industrial use

title: NEOPYBUTHRIN FOGGING OIL
html:
Description

Neopybuthrin Fogging Oil is a misting and fogging solution for the control of cockroaches, houseflies, moths, weevils and stored tobacco beetle. Also controls ants, bedbugs, mosquitoes, fish moths and fleas.

title: GLOSSINEX 200 SC
html:
Description

Glossinex is used for the control of tsetse fly by application to odour-baited targets and ground spray.

title: DYFLY
html:
Description

DYFLY contains methomyl, a carbamate insecticide for the control of houseflies and blowflies in and around animal housing, refuse tips, manure heaps and food handling plants.

title: COOPEX LARVICIDE EC
html:
Description

A permethrin based larvicide for the control of mosquito and housefly larvae.

title: COCKROACH POISON
html:
Description

Cockroach Poison an effective solution for the elimination of cockroach infestations.

title: CISLIN SC
html:
Description

Insecticide based on deltamethrin for the control of mosquitoes. It can also be used for crawling insects: cockroaches, bedbugs and fleas and for control of the tobacco beetle in warehouses.

title: ANT POISON
html:
Description

Ant Poison is an effective solution for the elimination of ant infestations

title: SYSTAMEX
html:
Description

Systamex is highly effective against immature and mature stages of all the major gastro-intestinal roundworms of cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, horses and donkeys. It kills nematode eggs thus reducing pasture contamination while maintaining a wide safety margin and may be safely used in pregnant and young animals

title: SYSTAMEX PLUS FLUKE
html:
Description

Systamex Plus is broad spectrum anthelmintic which is effective against adult and immature stages of all common roundworms and tapeworms and is highly effective against adult liver fluke for cattle.

title: COOPER TICK GREASE
html:
Description

Tick Grease is a ready to use aid to tick control for domestic livestock

title: TRIATIX
html:
Description

Triatix controls all stages of ticks and strains of ticks resistant to arsenic, organochlorines, organophosphates, carbamates and synthetic pyrethriods and is not subject to cross-resistance from other acaricides. This ectoparasiticide rapidly controls mange, mites and lice on cattle, small stock, pigs and dogs.

title: SUPADIP
html:
Description

For control of ectoparasites on cattle, horses, sheep, dogs and goats and fly maggots when used in feedlots and on manure heaps.

title: SULPHADIMIDINE
html:
Description

Sulphadimidine is an effective broad spectrum antibiotic against a wide range of bacteria, especially those causing diarrhea in poultry. It is effective against a wide range of coccidia species. It can be used for poultry, rabbits, lambs, kids and calves. Note that it is necessary to make up a fresh solution every day.

title: SPOT ON
html:
Description

SPOT ON is an effective dip that controls lice, ticks, nuisance and biting flies for cattle, including tsetse flies. The wide safety margin of SPOT ON allows it to be safe to use on all age groups of livestock as well as all stages of pregnancy.

title: NUTRAVIT
html:
Description

Nutravit is a water soluble mixture containing amino-acids, vitamins and electrolytes. This supplement is recommended for use in poultry of all ages during periods of stress and high temperatures, and as a feed supplement in calves, piglets and other domestic animals.

title: NOBIVAC RABIES
html:
Description

Nobivac Rabies is a highly stable inactivated, adjuvanted vaccine against Rabies that offers complete protection. This vaccine offers complete protection that lasts for a minimum of 3 years. For use in the immunization of all healthy mammals, including dogs, cats, cattle, sheep, goats, ferrets, foxes, horses and in principle all healthy animals against rabies.

title: Nobilis® MA5 + Clone 30
html:
Description

Nobilis® MA5 + Clone 30 is a live attenuated, freeze-dried vaccine, used for the immunisation of healthy chickens against the Massachusetts type of serologically related types of Infectious Bronchitis and against Newcastle Disease.

title: NOBILIS® GUMBORO D78
html:
Description

Nobilis® Gumboro D78 is a live freeze-dried vaccine for the immunisation of chickens against Infectious Bursal Disease (Gumboro).

title: NILZAN DRENCH
html:
Description

Nilzan Drench controls roundworms and liver fluke in cattle, sheep and goats. It is also highly convenient for use in lactating cows (zero milk withdrawal). It is safe for use in young pregnant animals. Very effective in controlling wire worm in sheep.

title: MILK SALVE
html:
Description

MILK SALVE is a modern emollient cream recommended as an aid in the prevention and treatment of cracked and chapped teats on dairy cattle, goats and sheep.

title: IMIZOL
html:
Description

Imizol cures Redwater (Babesiosis) and Gall sickness (Anaplasmosis) in cattle. It also prevents Asiatic Redwater for up to 4 weeks and African Redwater for up to 4 weeks in cattle. It is also used for the treatment of Biliary of dogs.

title: GOLDEN MASTRITE
html:
Description

Golden Mastrite is an iodine based teat dip treatment effective against the common mastitis-causing bacteria.

title: FLUXACUR NF
html:
Description

Fluxacur NF is an anti-parasitic remedy for the control of internal parasites in cattle, sheep and goats. It is used in the control of nasal bot in sheep and goats and itch mite in sheep. Additionally, Fluxacur NF is used as a liver fluke remedy against early, immature and adult liver fluke and giant liver fluke in cattle, sheep and goats.

title: FLAVECO
html:
Description

Flaveco is an antibiotic feed additive that promotes growth, improves feed conversions, reduces susceptibility to disease, improved carcass quality, milk production, egg production, yolk colour and improvements in overall animal performance. Flavomycin is a performance enhancer for use in pigs, poultry, cattle, rabbits and fish.

title: EX-IT – WOUND REMEDY
html:
Description

EX-IT is a multipurpose remedy that cures wounds and kills screwworms and ticks.

For topical application on cattle and all livestock, horses, wildlife, dogs and birds. A multi-purpose ready-to-use formulation which effectively:

  • Cures existing screw-worm infestation
  • Prevents screw-worm infestation of fresh wounds
  • Reduces bacterial contamination
  • Promotes wound healing
  • Kills ticks and expelled screw-worms
  • Kills alighting screw-worm flies preventing re-infestation

title: ECOTET
html:
Description

Ecotet is a broad spectrum antimicrobial soluble powder effective against bacterial infections, respiratory infections, gastroenteritis and other conditions sensitive to Tetracycline. For group treatment of poultry in the drinking water, individual treatment of calves, kids and lambs in the period prior to the commencement of ruminal function. May also be used in piglets, rabbits and foals.

Specially formulated for maximum performance in hard water areas where calcium levels reduce oxytetracycline activity.

title: DECATIX
html:
Description

Decatix is a concentrated formula for use as a dip wash or spray when diluted with water. Decatix is effective for the control of ticks, including organophosphate resistant strains, biting and nuisance flies as well as tsetse flies on cattle.

title: COOPERMYCIN 100
html:
Description

Coopermycin 100 (short acting) has same properties as Coopermycin LA, but is faster acting. This product features a rapid absorption into the blood stream and is suitable for a wide range of bacterial infections. This product can be used in cattle, sheep and pigs, and can be repeated daily as needed by intramuscular injection.

title: COOPERMYCIN LA
html:
Description

Coopermycin is a 20% long acting Oxytetracycline solution given by injection. This is a long lasting, fast acting, and high-performing broad spectrum antibiotic manufactured to the highest standards.

title: BUPARVEX
html:
Description

Buparvex is indicated for the treatment of Zimbabwean theileriosis (January Disease) caused by Theileria bovis and Buffalo derived theileriosis during outbreaks. It may be used in the incubation period of the disease or when clinical signs are apparent.

title: BRAVECTO
html:
Description

Bravecto is a tasty chewable tablet for the treatment and prevention of tick, flea and mite infestations in the dog family that lasts for 3 months.

title: BIMECTIN PLUS
html:
Description

Bimectin Plus offers convenience, value for money and efficacy. It is a broad spectrum treatment and control of internal and external parasites in cattle. The Ivermectin component inhibits the central nervous system functioning of parasites. It is effective against roundworms, lungworms, mange, sucking lice and some external parasites (blue ticks). The Clorsulon component is effective against adult liver flukes through inhibition of glycolytic pathways and depression of ATP levels.

title: AVOTAN
html:
Description

Avaton is a ready to use pour-on for the control of roundworms and resistant blue ticks in lactating dairy cows.

title: AMITIK DIP PACK
html:
Description

Amitik wettable powder controls all manner of ticks in various stages of development, including resistant strains. Amitik’s rapid expellant action causes ticks to quickly detach from the body and die, resulting in rapid healing of the tick bites. Effective for use on cattle, sheep and goats.

title: AMINO-VITAL
html:
Description

Amino-Vital is a highly concentrated solution of vitamins, minerals and amino acids for oral administration to domestic animals, particularly poultry. Amino-Vital assists with growth problems, skin disorders, as well as combats dietary deficiencies. For use with stress associated conditions:

  • transportation,
  • infection,
  • dietary change,
  • parasitic infestation
  • convalescence.

title: AIVLOSIN SOLUBLE
html:
Description

Aivlosin Soluble is used for treatment of some of the most important enteric and respiratory diseases in pigs and poultry. For veterinary use only.

title: AIVLOSIN FG50
html:
Description

Poultry

Used for the prevention and treatment of Mycoplasma bacterial diseases, including Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD) in broiler, breeder and layer chickens. For the prevention and treatment of diseases due to Clostridium perfringens (acute and subacute necrotic enteritis, wet litter, cholangiohepatitis), and Ornithobacterium rhinotracheale (ORT).

Swine

For the prevention and treatment of Porcine Proliferative Enteropathy (PPE)/lleitis, Swine Dysentery and Enzootic Pneumonia

title: AFRIVIT P
html:
Description

Afri-Vit P is a vitamin and amino acid supplement for poultry, pigs and calves
